description: This file defines the LocalPlugin class within the WPEFramework::Plugin::Rust namespace. The class implements the Rust::IPlugin interface and provides declarations for plugin lifecycle management, invocation, attachment, detachment, and interaction with Rust plugin functions. It also includes private members for managing Rust plugin function pointers, reference counting, and communication with Rust code.

classes.name: LocalPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class that interfaces with Rust code, manages plugin lifecycle, and handles communication between the C++ host and Rust implementation.
